ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Rcdll.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of rcdll.dll Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\rcdll\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Visual\\ Studio\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Windows\\ Kits\\\\")))
